verdict.rationale: Shopify documents the full chain. `create_checkout` converts carts into checkout sessions, `complete_checkout` will "Submit payment and place the order" once a payment credential is collected (with negotiated payment handlers such as com.google.pay), and UCP/AP2 describes cryptographically signed payment mandates tied to cart state. Confirmed orders are then readable via Order MCP and webhooks. The caveat is that direct completion is restricted to trusted Token-tier agents granted purchase permission; the default flow hands buyers off to the merchant's `continue_url` for payment, and escalations force that handoff. Missing for 10: Shopify-specific docs on how an agent obtains a delegated payment credential, self-serve access to the purchase-completion and order-webhook tiers, and hands-on evidence of a completed checkout (the runtime probe stopped at cart creation).
